c74object.name: evi_vosim_basic
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. A basic implementation of a 'vosim' formant oscillator
c74object.description:
evi_vosim_basic is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_vosim_basic is also available in MSP as: evi.vosim.basic~.
This is a 'raw' formant oscillator with low level controls capable of modelling the human voice, typically used in a bank of multiple oscillators to do so. However single evi.vosim.basic~ instances can provide novel oscillators for more generic synthesis, and is capable of ringing filtered-like tones. The VOSIM algorithm is inherently bandlimited.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ t:, m:, n:, a:, ∂a: } }

geninlet.name: t:
geninlet.digest: Pulse Width in ms. The width of a single pulse that makes up a formant. A typical use case is to control this parameter simultaneously with 'M' (inlet 2), for example on an XY pad.

geninlet.name: m:
geninlet.digest: Delay in ms. The delay at the end of a series of pulses, before the next formant is triggered. A typical use case is to control this parameter simultaneously with 'T' (inlet 1), for example on an XY pad.

geninlet.name: n:
geninlet.digest: # of Pulses. The number of pulses used to create a single formant.

geninlet.name: a:
geninlet.digest: Amplitude. The amplitude of the first pulse of the formant. A typical use case is to control this parameter simultaneously with '∂A' (inlet 5), for example on an XY pad.

geninlet.name: ∂a:
geninlet.digest: inc/dec (decay). The decay window over which the series of pulses envelope the formant. A typical use case is to control this parameter simultaneously with 'A' (inlet 4), for example on an XY pad.
